previous_assumption: docs/rental-domain-design.md §12 locked the call that a Project entity was 'exactly the premature module the working rules forbid' — projectName/projectLocation were kept as free-text fields on Requirement/Rental, with a migration path noted only if a real need appeared later.
correction: Business validated Projects are required. Implemented Project as a first-class renter-owned entity (projectCode/projectType/siteLocation/state/district/dates/status, active->completed|cancelled, race-free per-renter reference numbering PRJ-{year}-{n}). Requirement now carries a required project_id FK — backfilled for the 9 pre-existing rows via a one-time synthetic 'Pre-Project Records' project per renter, then locked NOT NULL as a real database invariant, not just an app-level convention. A Rental Company never manages a Project directly (project.manage is renter-only); it only ever sees Project context threaded through Requirement/Quotation/Rental, same denormalized-read pattern as machineAssetCode.
